A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same AR-CoPO work. All supplied pages, equations, tables and figures are readable and support reliable matching. v1's appendix is absent from v2; this is an identifiable omission rather than an extraction gap.

before.justification: v1 reports original AR-CoPO experiments on Self-Forcing and Causal-Forcing, including benchmark scores, training comparisons, ablations and qualitative samples.

after.justification: v2 retains original Self-Forcing alignment experiments, benchmark results and diagnostic analyses in Tables 1–3 and Figures 2 and 5–8.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.3 retain the same chunk-level forking, shared-noise construction, contrastive GRPO objective, consistency-model prediction distance, reference-buffer training and LoRA merging. Algorithm 1 is unchanged.

E1.justification: MovieGen Video Bench training, VBench and VideoAlign evaluation, and streaming text-to-video generation remain unchanged. The omitted Causal-Forcing experiments concern another model configuration within the same dataset and task coverage.

E2.justification: The dedicated comparison against unaligned Causal-Forcing in appendix Table 4 and Figure 9 is removed. Causal-Forcing remains a baseline in Table 1; the other main comparators and the SDE-GRPO comparison are unchanged.

E3.justification: The reported Causal-Forcing-specific evaluation configuration and merge-scale sweep, including scale 0.5, are omitted. Retained Self-Forcing protocols, metrics and default merge scale 0.8 are unchanged; the PDFs do not establish altered settings or reruns for those experiments.

E4.justification: v2 removes the Causal-Forcing merge-strength sensitivity study and associated visual-versus-semantic trade-off cases in Table 4 and Figure 9. The main noise-substitution study, training-strategy ablations and Self-Forcing merge-scale analysis remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, evaluation seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. The retained result tables and training curves use the same reporting practices.

E6.justification: All reported AR-CoPO-on-Causal-Forcing outcomes are removed, eliminating the quantitative and qualitative validation on a second backbone. These include Table 4's semi-on-policy VBench Total of 82.65 and VideoAlign Overall of 7.81, the remaining merge-scale results, and Figure 9's six prompt comparisons. Tables 1–3 and the retained qualitative results are unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations 1–4, the surrogate-policy definitions, normalized advantages and clipped optimization objective are unchanged. The removed appendix contains implementation and empirical material, with no additional formal derivations or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's three contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about chunk-level alignment, complementary semi-on-policy training, and improved Self-Forcing alignment and generalization.

C2.justification: Removing Section 5.2 and Figure 9's caption removes the interpretation that Causal-Forcing is more susceptible to reward hacking, the recommendation of scale 0.5, and the argument for applicability across both backbones. Main-text mechanism explanations and limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Deleting Section 5.1 removes the only explicit specifications of the ratio-clipping threshold 1e-4, initial-noise perturbation strength 0.5, two policy updates per GRPO iteration, and evaluation after 100 training iterations. These are important reproducibility details across the experiments. Main-text learning rate, group size, LoRA settings, GPU count and buffer size remain available.

R1.justification: v2 adds SALT to the introduction and bibliography, removes the prompt-encoding paper by Ma et al. and EasyRef, and adds an introductory citation to the already referenced LongLive. The relationship to Neighbor GRPO and the central research positioning remain unchanged; Neighbor GRPO's publication update represents the same cited work.

P1.justification: The scientific main-text prose is essentially unchanged. v2 removes the appendix sections, adds keywords and acknowledgements, and updates affiliations and running headers, without substantial rewriting or reorganization of the main argument.

P2.justification: Appendix Table 4 and Figure 9 are removed. Figure 1 is reduced in size, Figure 2 shifts vertically, and front matter and references reflow. The retained tables and figures preserve their substantive displays.

improvement.justification: v2 preserves the method and primary Self-Forcing evidence but loses reproducibility settings and all presented alignment results on a second backbone. Section 4 still directs readers to the now-absent Causal-Forcing supplement. This weakens reproducibility and support for broader applicability; the limited citation and presentation updates do not offset those losses.
